name: k25-kirana-offer
prompt:
A small kirana shop in Nagpur at mid-morning: the owner (a man in his forties, a cream half-sleeve shirt, a red tilak on his forehead, short neat hair, a moustache) stands behind his counter under hanging strips of solid-colour snack packets, holding his phone in both hands and reading it with a slight smile; the phone's screen shows exactly the offer screen in the reference image (a white page with Hindi text, a large price, a green button at the bottom), sharp and upright, filling the screen, turned a little toward the camera; behind him shelves of jars and a few MUNCHLY cartons; a customer's shoulder at the edge of the frame. Medium shot, daylight from the street, his face and the phone's screen sharp.

Photorealistic cinematic film still, live action, 35 mm, eye level, shallow depth of field, natural light, real skin and fabric. The cartons are kraft-brown with a sage-green band and the word MUNCHLY printed once in bold dark-green capital letters on each carton's side, nothing else written on them; the snack packets are solid orange, green and red with no lettering; the Mango Drink packs are small plain yellow-orange tetra packs with a mango drawn on them and no lettering. No other text, letters, numbers, logos or watermarks anywhere. No number plate. No children.
